findings.summary: The 'base threshold 0.30' annotation ends 2 px from the sample-3 marker on the same baseline; at the rendered size the trailing digits and the dot read as one mark, and the generator's save-time check tests only canvas bounds, never text-versus-data overlap, so the crowding passes uncaught.

The left panel's y axis says only 'judge probability' but plots two different quantities on one axis: each coloured mark is its answer's contradicts mass and each grey mark is its says-nothing mass. The dotted 0.30 line spans the whole panel although it governs only the contradicts series, so the ten grey markers read as sitting above a threshold the base veto never applies to them.

Legend and marks do not match: the 'base veto silent' swatch is an open circle with a white interior, but the three silent contradiction marks render as blue discs inside a dark ring, because the open marker is drawn over the blue one. The 'contradicts' swatch carries no ring although every blue mark in the panel does, so a reader matching swatches to marks finds no white-centred circle anywhere in the data.

The grey label text is #929292 on white, a 3.1:1 contrast. The two numbers a reader most needs, the 0.30 threshold label and the 'base veto 7 of 10' count, are the lowest-contrast text on the figure and fall below the 4.5:1 that 14 px text requires.

The caption says 'filled marks are the base veto's firings', but the ten grey filled marks are not firings; only the seven black ones are. Following the caption, a reader counts twenty filled marks against a stated seven firings.

The right panel's 'fixed veto 10 of 10' is drawn from the sample count n rather than from the recorded head_fires, so the same figure would still print 10 of 10 if a sampled answer stopped firing; the two agree here only because matched-answers.json records head_fires 10 of 10.

RUBRIC legibility: defect: readable at a glance, but the left panel's y axis reads only 'judge probability' while carrying two different masses at once, the contradicts mass of each coloured mark and the says-nothing mass of each grey mark, and the 0.30 rule governs only the contradicts series.
RUBRIC data_ink: pass: the ink is markers, labels and one dotted rule; no fills, bands or shading compete with the data.
RUBRIC decoration: pass: no gradient, background fill, gridline or styled theme; both panels carry only a left spine and the shared bottom spine.
RUBRIC contrast: defect: the grey label text (#929292 on white, 3.1:1) is below the 4.5:1 that the rendered 14 px text needs; the blue label reads 5.5:1 and the near-black text reads far higher.
RUBRIC table_form: pass: the panel plots positional data, not tabular content; the two-count right panel is a small axis reading rather than a table.
RUBRIC label_collision: defect: nothing is clipped and no label overlaps another, but 'base threshold 0.30' ends 2 px from the sample-3 marker on the same baseline and reads as touching it.
FINDING docs/figures/sn-review-through-jev/srtj-docs-switch-causes/matched-answers.svg non-blocking: the 'base threshold 0.30' annotation ends 2 px from the sample-3 marker on the same baseline; at the rendered size the trailing digits and the dot read as one mark.
FINDING docs/figures/sn-review-through-jev/srtj-docs-switch-causes/matched-answers.svg non-blocking: the y axis says only 'judge probability' but carries the contradicts mass of the coloured marks and the says-nothing mass of the grey marks on one axis, while the dotted 0.30 line spans the panel although it governs only the contradicts series.
FINDING docs/figures/sn-review-through-jev/srtj-docs-switch-causes/matched-answers.svg non-blocking: the 'base veto silent' legend swatch is an open circle with a white interior, but the silent contradiction marks render as blue discs inside a dark ring; the 'contradicts' swatch carries no ring although every blue mark does.
FINDING docs/figures/sn-review-through-jev/srtj-docs-switch-causes/matched-answers.svg non-blocking: grey label text at #929292 on white is 3.1:1, below the 4.5:1 the rendered 14 px text needs, and it carries the two numbers a reader most needs.
FINDING docs/figures/sn-review-through-jev/srtj-docs-switch-causes/matched-answers.svg non-blocking: the caption's 'filled marks are the base veto's firings' is contradicted by the ten grey filled marks that do not fire.
FINDING docs/figures/sn-review-through-jev/srtj-docs-switch-causes/matched-answers.svg non-blocking: the right panel's 'fixed veto 10 of 10' is drawn from the sample count rather than the recorded head_fires.
VERDICT: 6 rubric items verdicted on the single attached PNG, 0 blocking findings and 6 non-blocking, judged from the rendered image at 1399x720 px with the figure's own generator script and data JSON read as corroboration.
